description: Hand-written cases for the LLM-judged consolidation in reflect. Each user holds families of distinct facts that share wording (different events, periods or items: all must stay current), updates of one attribute (the older value must stop being current), and unrelated facts. Updates marked loggedOutOfOrder are written newest first, so their creation order is the reverse of their validity order. Written before any measurement.
